exclusion_reason: The cross-lane fallback chain consumes the front-door ranking and walks candidate lanes in confidence order: each lane's structural precondition is evaluated (a refused binary, an undetected build system, an absent engine fingerprint, a non-pre-Win32 image), the first lane whose precondition holds becomes the carried candidate, every skipped lane records its per-hop reason, and an exhausted chain terminates in a bounded no-lane state. The benchmark stays red because a carried candidate is a structural lane match only — no candidate lane has a passing runtime, so no title is actually carried to a running state, under the BPTK-002 corpus denominator.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the fallback chain hops on the declared precondition failure with recorded reason and terminates bounded.
expected_failing_assertion: A carried candidate is a structural match; no lane has a passing runtime, so the chain never proves a title runs.
active_gate_evidence: test/ingest.test.mjs asserts a plain PE32 carried as a binary-lane candidate, a refused binary falling to the engine lane with a recorded hop, a bounded no-lane terminal state for an unroutable input, and real-CLI reachability that never asserts the title runs.
procedure: Fail the primary precondition on the fixture and assert the declared next lane.
Assert the hop reason is recorded.
Exhaust the chain and assert the bounded no-lane result.
